'''Culhan Carand''' is an [[Andoran]] noble. His wife is [[Aemlyn Carand]]. 

== Appearance ==
He has a square face.

== Activities ==
He was exiled with his wife by Queen [[Morgase Trakand]] under the influence of Lord [[Gaebril]].

He enters the city quietly when [[Rand al'Thor]] disposes of Lord Gaebril and stays with Lord [[Pelivar Coelan]]. 

He meets with the [[Salidar]] delegation on the border of Andor.
